annotations.title: Create Coinbase Base L2 USDC Checkout Session

description: Create a hosted Coinbase Onchain Payment & x402 browser/QR checkout session settling in USDC or USDT on Base L2 or Ethereum for a human operator. Use for clickable hosted Coinbase Pay URLs (use calligraphy_get_crypto_payment_intent for headless agent transfers). Requires job_id; returns JSON coinbase_checkout_url and deposit_address. Example: job_id='job_01', currency='USDC'.

currency.description: Settlement stablecoin currency symbol ('USDC' or 'USDT') for checkout.

job_id.description: Compiled 0-DRC job identifier requiring Coinbase checkout session.

name: calligraphy_create_coinbase_checkout
